requires_note: Each condition under `requires` is an obligation at every call, which `una check` proves (`spec/12 §3`): it reports U5001 when the condition is refuted and U5002 when it is unknown (`spec/12 §6`), and `una run`, `una test` and `una build` refuse a package with an obligation that is not proved (`spec/22 §2`).
